cohort: 880 pregnant women with GDM and their newborns
finding: Overweight or obesity before pregnancy, poor blood glucose control during pregnancy, and improper neonatal feeding were associated with an increased risk of neonatal hypoglycemia in infants born to mothers with GDM.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was significantly different between the groups of women with gestational diabetes who did and did not experience neonatal hypoglycemia.
